value.rationale: Quantifies Shkarin’s explicitly motivated condition at the exact threshold across all q, and completely reduces the nonlinear tail-weak-null optimization for all normalized finite-dimensional radial extensions. The dimension-independent sharp value and isometric classification distinguish the quantitative phenomenon from known qualitative non-tameness and offer a reproducible basis for studying perturbation stability.
